name: Dumbbell Suitcase Carry
steps: Stand tall holding a heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side as if carrying a suitcase, keeping both shoulders level.
Brace your abs and obliques firmly to resist tilting toward or away from the weight.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps over the target distance while keeping your posture upright and eyes forward.
Set the dumbbell down safely, then switch hands and carry the same distance on the opposite side.
tips: Hold the dumbbell slightly off your thigh so it does not bounce against your leg as you walk.
Keep your collarbones level as you walk and let the loaded arm hang long.
